The '''Elgit&ndash;M'Hanna Corridor''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that connected the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Elgit]], [[Sakifwanna]] and [[M'Hanna]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Elgit&ndash;M'Hanna Corridor was first depicted in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], and was first named in ''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]'', a [[2015]] sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' [[roleplaying game]], published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].
